paragraphs: He was a great man in the Second Temple period, appointed over the vestments in the Temple, and he is mentioned in Shekalim, chapter 5, mishnah 1.[^1]

notes.text: פ״ה מ״א explicitly gives Shekalim chapter 5 mishnah 1, without independent named-edition verification. Great man, Second Temple setting and appointed-over-vestments role remain Hyman’s claims. The heading supplies no personal title, and the office does not supply a Rabbi expansion or bind this name to other Pinchas notices.
